school.school_name: 専門学校浜松工科自動車大学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve an official-index-linked WordPress disclosure page where the current target-year evidence is in the link label, not the PDF body.
search_queries: 専門学校浜松工科自動車大学校 令和8年度 様式第2号
専門学校浜松工科自動車大学校 機関要件 様式第2号
steps: Start from the Shizuoka official-index artifact row for 専門学校浜松工科自動車大学校.
Follow the official-index link to https://kohka-h.ac.jp/disclose.
Find the public-disclosure link labeled 令和８年度 様式第２号.
Open the linked PDF and verify that its body contains 専門学校浜松工科自動車大学校 and 様式第２号.
Accept it as strict FY2026 evidence because the link label supplies the target fiscal year even though the PDF body itself has no explicit 令和8年度 label.

reusable_rules: On WordPress disclosure pages, use local link text such as 令和８年度 様式第２号 as trusted fiscal-year evidence for the linked target-form PDF.
Accept a target-form PDF whose body contains the school name and 様式第２号 when the PDF body lacks an explicit fiscal-year label but the local link label proves the target fiscal year.
Keep generic documents in the same current-year disclosure block, such as 学校情報, 学生便覧, 組織図, and 役員名簿, out of strict target success even when they share the same 令和８年度 heading.
anti_patterns: Do not require the PDF body to repeat 令和8年度 when the immediately associated anchor text carries the target-year evidence.
Do not let generic current-year documents outrank a current-year 様式第２号 link merely because they appear earlier in the same disclosure section.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the official-index-linked WordPress disclosure page. Project HTML extraction ranked the 令和８年度 様式第２号 candidate as a WordPress PDF link; source-side PDF text extraction verified 専門学校浜松工科自動車大学校 and 様式第２号 in the PDF body. The PDF body does not repeat 令和8年度, so this case preserves link-local year evidence as the strict success signal.
